title: A caller who can reach the temporal-proxy gRPC listener, with or without a valid credential, can grow the proxy's…
description: A vulnerability in temporal-proxy versions 0.1.0-alpha.20260716 through 1.2.0 allows an unauthenticated caller who can reach the gRPC listener to cause unbounded memory growth. This occurs because the proxy records metrics for every distinct gRPC method name received, including those rejected by authentication or routing, without removing old metric series. The issue is fixed in versions 1.0.2, 1.1.2, and 1.2.1.
